cdp.title: In-app browser connection
cdp.connection: How the agent reaches the in-app browser
cdp.about: A local connection (127.0.0.1, on a new port each launch) that reaches only the browser view, never mu's own window. Other programs on this computer can use it too, with the configurations below. It's open only while the agent is allowed to use the in-app browser, which you set in the in-app browser settings.
cdp.mcpConfigHint: Paste this into your MCP client config to connect to local Chrome DevTools.
cdp.disabledHint: Not running: the agent isn't allowed to use the in-app browser.
cdp.playwrightMcpConfigHint: Connects Playwright MCP through the CDP endpoint, for accessibility snapshots and browser automation.

assistant.botTokenDesc: Open Telegram, find @BotFather, and send /newbot to get your bot token.
assistant.step1: Open Telegram and search for your bot
assistant.step2: Send it any message or /start to begin pairing
assistant.step3: A pairing request will appear below. Click "Approve" to authorize the user.
assistant.step4: Once approved, you can chat with the assistant in Telegram.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.slackBotTokenDesc: Create a Slack app, install it to your workspace, then copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-).
assistant.slackAppTokenDesc: Turn on Socket Mode and generate an app-level token with the connections:write scope (xapp-).
assistant.slackTokensRequired: Enter and test your Slack tokens first
assistant.slackStep1: Open Slack and mention your bot in a channel, or send it a DM
assistant.slackStep2: Send any message or @mention to start pairing
assistant.slackStep3: A pairing request will appear below. Click "Approve" to authorize the user.
assistant.slackStep4: Once approved, you can chat with the assistant in Slack.
assistant.discordBotTokenDesc: Create a Discord application, add a bot, enable the MESSAGE CONTENT intent and copy the bot token.
assistant.discordStep1: Open Discord and mention your bot in a channel, or send it a DM
assistant.discordStep2: Send any message or @mention to start pairing
assistant.discordStep3: A pairing request will appear below. Click "Approve" to authorize the user.
assistant.discordStep4: Once approved, you can chat with the assistant in Discord.
